checked_boundaries: All80 coefficients independently integrated; exact rational null families checked analytically. Signed displacement modal ratios do not establish acoustic amplitude, bridge force, timbre judgment or listener response.

Geometry is ideal equal-tempered vibrating length, not measured compensated/action-dependent string length or observed picking motion. Buffer coordinates have no documented physical bridge-origin mapping.
Source compact tent times smoothed random noise is not ideal full-end triangular displacement at rest. Recursive noise smoothing has no demonstrated strict anti-alias bandlimit.

Threshold count means first n with A0*r^n<=1e-3; sample index0 is a modeled state and does not add an update. Source stops updating thereafter, so the infinite exponential extension does not describe continued stored-state decay.
